project.name: Baobab ERP Events Bundle
project.description: Subscribes to iDempiere's own OSGi EventAdmin model-change events (the standard org.osgi.service.event.EventHandler contract iDempiere's AbstractEventHandler is built on) and, on a real C_BPartner create/update, calls the registered CanonicalMappingResolver service to resolve its canonical Party identity (ADR-ERP-007). Hooks the asynchronous PO_POST_CREATE/PO_POST_UPADTE topics specifically because they fire after the triggering transaction has committed, so the resulting blocking HTTP call to baobab-app never runs inside a document transaction (ADR-ERP-004, INV-ERP-EXT-011).
